name: SampleWallet
description: An attacker reportedly obtained private keys that SampleWallet stored in users' web profiles and moved funds out of about 19 accounts. Affected users are urged to move remaining funds to a new wallet with a fresh seed phrase.

name: SampleSwap V3
description: An attacker exploited a rounding flaw in SampleSwap V3's burn() function to remove liquidity repeatedly.
